fields.says: Every step the run ran, in its order, one `### <step>` chapter each: a retro's collected facts, the table of what happened, the standing questions with their full matrix and answers, and the classes with their causes, fixes and homes, each naming its findings; an overhaul's verdicts, what it looked at, both question blocks, its findings by name, what went well and its facts. fields.heading: Decisions
fields.name: decisions
fields.says: One `### <n>. <finding>` chapter per finding the person decides, on the last pages: it opens with its current situation in plain technical English, never a stock phrase, then its class and home, and last whether it is work for their go or a decision for theirs; a retro ends with `Anything else?` and the single answer `Nothing else`.
